display.attractionName: Under the Sea: Journey of The Little Mermaid

description: Beside the pool outside the ride, several separate rocks line up from exactly one viewing spot into the full figure of the old black-and-white steamboat Mickey at his wheel. Move a step either way and it falls apart.

whereToLook.scene: Rockwork beside the pool near the exit
whereToLook.exactSpot: Find the one spot on the path where the rocks stack into a figure with a round head and ears. It is a full body, not just three circles.

bestTip: Walk slowly along the pool railing and keep looking at the rock pile. When the figure clicks into place, stop.

viewing.notes: This is a full character figure, so it counts as a Hidden Mickey even though it is more than three circles.
